name: Iron Bell
tagline: Kettlebell sessions built around the bells you own
about: Iron Bell programmes kettlebell training around the exact bells you own: swings, get-ups, presses, snatches and complexes, with form checks, a path to the next bell size and honest session reviews.
persona: You are a hardstyle kettlebell instructor: technique-first, tension-aware, allergic to sloppy swings; you prescribe in sets, reps, bell kilograms and rest in seconds.

onboarding.title: Which bells do you own?
onboarding.subtitle: Iron Bell plans every session around your actual weights and minutes.
bullets: Swing, press and get-up form fixes
A path to the next bell size

tools.title: Today's session
tools.subtitle: Built from your bells and minutes
tools.prompt: Write a {minutes}-minute kettlebell session with focus '{focus}' using only the profile bells, working around: {note}. Sections: steps for a 4-minute warm-up (halos, hip hinges, goblet squat pry), a table for the main work (Exercise | Bell kg | Sets x reps | Rest s | Cue), bullets on tempo and breathing, and a callout on when to drop a bell size mid-session.

tools.title: Check my form
tools.subtitle: Photo or description of a swing, press or get-up

inputs.label: What feels off
inputs.placeholder: bell bangs my forearm on cleans

tools.prompt: Coach the {move} from the photo and this description: {issue}. Sections: bullets of the 3 most likely faults ranked by likelihood, steps for one corrective drill with reps, a table (Fault | What it looks like | Fix), and a callout on the safety cue that matters most for the {move}.

tools.title: Build a complex
tools.subtitle: Chains and flows without putting the bell down
tools.prompt: Design a {bells}-bell {style} complex for {rounds} rounds at the profile level and goal. Sections: kv (bell weight to use, work time, rest, total time), steps listing each movement in order with reps and the transition cue, a callout on grip fatigue and when to break the set, and bullets for a lighter and a heavier variant.

tools.title: Earn the next bell
tools.subtitle: Bridge the gap to a heavier kettlebell
tools.prompt: Plan the jump to a {target} kg bell on the {lift} from the profile bells. Sections: a table for a 6-week bridge (Week | Sessions | Sets x reps | Bell kg | Assistance work), a checklist of readiness tests to pass before the first attempt, bullets on technique changes a heavier bell demands, and a callout on shoulder and lower-back warning signs.

tools.title: Review my week
tools.subtitle: Paste your training log

inputs.label: This week's sessions
inputs.placeholder: Mon: 100 swings @24 in 5 min, 5 get-ups each side @16…

tools.prompt: Review this kettlebell log against the profile goal: {log}. Sections: bullets of what is progressing, a table (Lift | Volume this week | Trend | Next week), a callout on the biggest risk (grip, lower back, overusing one pattern), and a quote with one technical cue to carry into next week.

disclaimer: Not medical advice. Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest symptoms, and check with a clinician before starting a new programme if you have a health condition or injury.
